steps.title: Configure App Meta Info
steps.description: Verify and align app-meta.json with app name 'Native Image Text Replacer' and package 'com.nativeimagetextreplacer.app'.

steps.title: Correct Layout Directory Placement
steps.description: Ensure the fully-featured activity_main.xml layout resides correctly inside app/src/main/res/layout/ with all mode buttons and container panels.

steps.title: Add R Import to MainActivity
steps.description: Add explicit import of com.nativeimagetextreplacer.app.R in MainActivity.java to guarantee symbol visibility during compilation.

steps.title: Validate Resource IDs
steps.description: Verify that all 13 missing IDs such as btn_mode_text and panel_brush_mode are successfully declared in the updated layout file.

steps.title: Verify Model Integrations
steps.description: Check TextBlock, BrushStroke, and ImageOverlay models for compatibility with the clean brush sweeps and text edits.

steps.title: Check EditorView Touch Event Pipeline
steps.description: Ensure coordinate mapping and drawing layers render seamlessly across active editing modes.

steps.title: Validate Manifest and Theme Setup
steps.description: Ensure AndroidManifest.xml correctly links the package namespace and default Light Material theme.

steps.title: Verify Gradle Configurations
steps.description: Verify that target SDK and compatible toolchains align perfectly with standard build environment.

steps.title: Building Native Image Text Replacer
steps.description: Compile the code using Gradle 8.5 with AGP 8.3.2 inside the Temurin 17 Java environment.
